lines.text: The LORD tells Moses and Aaron that Israel may eat any animal with a split hoof that chews the cud.
The camel, the rock badger and the rabbit chew the cud but have no divided hoof, so they are unclean.
Of the creatures in the water, Israel may eat anything with wings and feathers.
Israel may eat locusts, katydids, crickets and grasshoppers, which have jointed legs for digging on the ground.
The LORD tells Israel to be holy because He is holy, and He brought them up out of Egypt.
